budget_basis: 10000 PPO commitments, two cost-specific seller responses per commitment.
deduplication: Reject repeated canonical threshold tables before seller evaluation, without charging the repeated draw.
grid_reference: Johnson et al. 15 prices equally spaced in [1,2.1]
holdout_usage: All 50 fresh responses are reporting only and cannot affect policy selection.
name: Johnson uniform random search, single pass, 10000 policies
policy_class: all symmetric canonical admission-threshold tables on the Johnson 15-price grid
scope: One newly seeded search. 10000 unique policies times two costs matches one PPO run: 20000 seller responses. Evaluate the single winner on 25 fresh seller seeds per cost. No finalist rescoring or intermediate validation.
selection: Highest single-pass mean across both costs; replace the incumbent only for an improvement exceeding 1e-12, otherwise keep the earliest candidate. Freeze the winner before any fresh evaluation.
